root: ^Agathol? Oh grams don't get me started. I have been infatuated with that place ever since I was a little girl. Barely felt like I had a choice not to.
^All the tales of that place, they’re all so horrifying and fascinating are they not? And all the wild weapons and stuff that's been found down there, makes me giddy just thinking about it!
^Then why don't you go down there yourself? You seem more than capable
^Me? I mean I guess. That's what my family wanted for me at least. But no, smithing is more my thing. I love it just as much.
